newsitem.title: INDIA: Calcutta shares fall on low volumes, dull trade.
newsitem.headline: Calcutta shares fall on low volumes, dull trade.

text.p: Calcutta shares ended lower on Friday on low volumes and dull trade, brokers said.
Large volumes were seen only State Bank of India. Most other blue-chips eased on thin volumes, they said.

"The market is very weak. There is no interest and all the short covering is over and dullness has set in. A recovery is not in sight because none is willing to get into investment buying," said Aprajit Sharma of brokers Jet Age Securities.
Brokers said that Indian mutual funds too forced sales of moderate sized lots during the day but much of these sales were restricted to private deals.
